title: Ragupati Ragava (Ram Dhun)
about: Traditional Hindu bhajan (Ram Dhun), popularized by M. K. Gandhi’s ashram. It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. B (kirtans), song #265, printed page B(49), PDF p.144 (typeset, letters above notes; 3 settings in book — this is the notated one).
melody_note: Encoded from the songbook’s typeset notation (book B #265, printed page B(49), PDF p.144), which prints a LETTER NAME above every note — the highest-confidence source among the book’s notated songs. Four strains encoded: two Raghupati strains, the Ishwara Krishna strain, and the Rama Rama Jaya strain.
verdict: Verdict: pending, but confidence is higher than the hand-drawn pages because the note letters are printed in the book itself. The Ram Dhun (Gandhi’s bhajan) is also globally published for an independent check.
